title: Freeze
description: Paper plugin that lets you freeze time, players and the entire server in place
body:
Freeze is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets operators freeze the server and prevent players from moving using PacketEvents. It cancels player movement packets while keeping admins with `freeze.bypass` permission free to move.

### Commands
Use `/freeze start` to freeze and `/freeze stop` to unfreeze.

### Permissions
Players with `freeze.bypass` are free to move when the server is frozen 

### Donations
Freeze is completely free to use.
